basic_details.job_title: JIPMER Project Technician III/Nurse Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Preventive and Social Medicine at the Jawaharlal Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education and Research (JIPMER), Puducherry, will hold a walk-in written test at 9:00 AM and an interview from 2:00 PM on 16 November 2026 for one contract post of Project Technician-III/Nurse in the ICMR-funded IR-CALM project. Pay is Rs. 20,000/- + 20% HRA = @Rs.24,000/-. The essential qualification is 12th in Science + Diploma (MLT/DMLT or equivalent) with five years' experience, or B.Sc. how_to_apply: Applications are received from individuals by hand on the date of the walk-in interview. No online form or email address is given in the notice.
Fill in the application format REC-03 (Application for the post of Project Technician-III/Nurse, for the project IR-CALM), printed on A4 paper, in block letters with a blue pen.
Affix a recent passport size photo in the space given. Do not staple it.
Give a valid email ID and mobile number, which are compulsory.
Attach one set of photocopies of all certificates, self-attested, in the order of the checklist.
Bring all original certificates for verification. Without them, candidature cannot be considered.
Hand in the application on 16 November 2026 at Ground floor, JISPH, JIPMER.
Proof of identity (copy of Aadhaar card/Voter ID/Passport/Driving License)
Certificate in support of age (Tenth equivalent/High School Certificate)
Any other relevant document, specified in the form
Proof, if the applicant states SC/ST/OBC status

The form also asks for details of previous employment with proof of work, and contact details of previous employers. Candidates may attach a CV with the form, but an application with a CV alone, without the prescribed form and certificates, will be rejected.

Department of Preventive and Social Medicine

Reducing cardiovascular risk through 'Community Action for Lifestyle Modification' in a high-burden noncommunicable disease setting: A type 3 Hybrid Effectiveness Implementation study (IR CALM) Project
Till the end of the project, 31 December 2026, extendable till June 2027 after approval of project extension
By hand on the date of the walk-in interview

content_sections.heading: About JIPMER
content_sections.text: JIPMER is a postgraduate medical education and research institute at Dhanwantri Nagar, Puducherry. This post is a contract project post in a research project funded by an external agency, ICMR, and sits under the Department of Preventive and Social Medicine. The Project Investigator is Dr. Subitha L.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice gives one post, Project Technician-III/Nurse, with two alternative essential qualifications. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age. The application form has a line for age on the last date for application. Experience in sample collection and clinical examination Working knowledge of MS Office, MS Word, MS PowerPoint Experience in field work and data collection Proficiency in speaking, writing and reading Tamil and English Qualification and experience should be in a relevant discipline/field and in a reputed institution/organization. The experience should have been gained after acquiring the essential qualification. Qualification, experience, other terms and conditions may be relaxed or altered at the discretion of the Principal Investigator. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

rows.essential_qualification: 12th in Science + Diploma (MLT/ DMLT / or equivalent) + Five Years Experience in relevant subject / field, OR B.Sc. Nursing + two years' experience in relevant subject

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated remuneration is Rs. 20,000/- + 20% HRA = @Rs.24,000/-. The consolidated salary of the post may vary from time to time, and no other allowance or facilities other than the consolidated salary shall be extended. The likely duration is till the end of the project, 31 December 2026, extendable till June 2027 after approval of project extension. The engagement may be extended or curtailed at the discretion of the Project Investigator.

content_sections.heading: JIPMER Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Provide technical support for the project Assist in data collection, data entry, and management Blood sample collection through door-to-door visits Intervention administration Support fieldwork, including coordination with healthcare facilities and community stakeholders Maintain accurate project records, documentation, and assist in preparing regular reports and updates Logistics management Assist in organizing workshops, training sessions, and dissemination activities Perform any other duties assigned by the Principal Investigator (PI) to support project goals

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for JIPMER Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications are received from individuals by hand on the date of the walk-in interview. No online form or email address is given in the notice. Fill in the application format REC-03 (Application for the post of Project Technician-III/Nurse, for the project IR-CALM), printed on A4 paper, in block letters with a blue pen. Affix a recent passport size photo in the space given. Do not staple it. Give a valid email ID and mobile number, which are compulsory. Attach one set of photocopies of all certificates, self-attested, in the order of the checklist. Bring all original certificates for verification. Without them, candidature cannot be considered. Hand in the application on 16 November 2026 at Ground floor, JISPH, JIPMER. Proof of identity (copy of Aadhaar card/Voter ID/Passport/Driving License) Certificate in support of age (Tenth equivalent/High School Certificate) Degrees/Diplomas Experience certificates Any other relevant document, specified in the form Proof, if the applicant states SC/ST/OBC status The form also asks for details of previous employment with proof of work, and contact details of previous employers. Candidates may attach a CV with the form, but an application with a CV alone, without the prescribed form and certificates, will be rejected.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: After evaluation of the application form, eligible candidates will attend a written test and walk-in interview. The interview is for candidates who qualify in the written test. The written test is at 9:00 AM. It covers basics of public health, epidemiology, data collection and management, research ethics, community engagement, field implementation, MS Office, and phlebotomy with safe sample collection and handling procedures. The interview starts at 2:00 PM onwards. Topics are communication skills, managerial skills, technical knowledge, past project experience and research experience.

faq.question: Q1. When is the JIPMER Project Technician-III/Nurse walk-in interview?
faq.answer: It is on 16 November 2026. The written test is at 9:00 AM and the interview is from 2:00 PM onwards for candidates who qualify in the written test.

faq.question: Q2. Where is the walk-in held?
faq.answer: The venue is Ground floor, JISPH, JIPMER.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the JIPMER Project Technician-III/Nurse post?
faq.answer: It is 12th in Science + Diploma (MLT/ DMLT / or equivalent) + Five Years Experience in relevant subject / field, or B.Sc. Nursing + two years' experience in relevant subject.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is up to 30 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary?
faq.answer: The consolidated remuneration is Rs. 20,000/- + 20% HRA = @Rs.24,000/-.

faq.question: Q6. Is any allowance paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no other allowance or facilities other than the consolidated salary shall be extended, and that the consolidated salary may vary from time to time.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Fill the prescribed application format and hand it in on 16 November 2026 with one set of self-attested photocopies of all certificates. Bring the originals for verification.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: The application form is evaluated first. Eligible candidates then attend a written test and an interview, and the interview is for those who qualify in the written test.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. It is a contract position for the project, likely till 31 December 2026 and extendable till June 2027 after approval of project extension. The person engaged has no claim to any regular post in JIPMER.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
